scope: One-action development diagnostic, not a controller change, M5 pass, or holdout.
pairing: Replay the reference configuration, scene, seed, control commands and observations through the specified world tick. Verify the trace and perception prefix against the source. At the original selection site, restrict the existing v1.8 guarded chooser to the one registered distance. No bypass of a refusal. Require matching RGB-D, arm configuration, camera, grip and tissue state immediately before the selected motion across variants. The original candidate's next observation must reproduce the reference. No follow-on recovery or closure; a refusal is reported rather than substituted.
diagnosis: On real post-motion RGB-D, check direct current front with mapped progress and valid scissors, then stage-specific pose and sweep checks; keep short advances that do not engage the front distinct from useful progress. A visible alternative warrants a two-bite test, not a claim of cutting success. For scoring only, compare the actual image with a render at identical sim time with only PSM2 and its markers hidden and then restored. At the truth front and in the next 2.5 mm by +/-1.5 mm forward patch, report cutter-changed pixel fractions and actual vs restored sheet support. Inspect aligned close-ups; do not label a whole frame occluded from one pixel, or classify an ambiguous edge as visible. Raw depth images are pre-noise; estimator uses the reference noise seed. Conclusions apply only to these checkpoints and distances.
